note: Curated reference facts about common maker modules. Not seller facts and not verified: every entry has verified=false until a maintainer checks each value against the cited source. Module variants differ; the rules engine never treats these values as an offer's declared specification.

entries.name: Nano V3 compatible (CH340, old bootloader)
entries.verify: If uploads fail, select 'ATmega328P (Old Bootloader)' and install the CH340 driver.

entries.name: NodeMCU v2 (Amica, CP2102)
entries.notes: Silkscreen uses D-labels: D1 = GPIO5, D2 = GPIO4, D4 = GPIO2 (LED_BUILTIN).

entries.name: NodeMCU v3 (LoLin, CH340)
entries.notes: Wider than v2: covers both breadboard rows. D1 = GPIO5, D2 = GPIO4.

entries.name: ESP-01 / ESP-01S
entries.notes: Needs a 3.3 V supply that can deliver about 300 mA peaks.

entries.name: STM32F411 Black Pill
entries.notes: Only pins marked FT are 5 V tolerant; treat the board as 3.3 V.

entries.name: LilyGO T5 ESP32 e-paper board
entries.notes: Panel size and driver IC vary by revision; confirm before porting code.

entries.name: GY-BME280 5 V module (with regulator)
entries.notes: Level shifting varies by maker; logic tolerance is unknown.

changes.text: DHT11 reads about 0–50 °C in 1 °C steps (DHT22: -40–80 °C in 0.1 °C steps); refuse it for sub-zero or decimal readings and use an AHT20 or SHT31 instead.

entries.name: HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor
entries.notes: ECHO drives 5 V; 3.3 V boards need a divider. Some sellers ship HC-SR04P under this name.

entries.name: JSN-SR04T waterproof ultrasonic sensor
entries.notes: Minimum range is about 25 cm, much longer than HC-SR04.

entries.name: Resistive soil moisture sensor (FC-28 / YL-69)
entries.notes: Probe corrodes when powered continuously.

entries.name: Capacitive soil moisture sensor v1.2
entries.notes: Many clones use an NE555 that needs 5 V; analog output range differs between batches.

entries.name: ACS712 5 A current sensor
entries.notes: Range variant (5/20/30 A) is in the part suffix; output swings around 2.5 V.

entries.name: MQ-2 gas sensor module
entries.notes: Heater draws about 150 mA; needs burn-in.

entries.name: MAX30102 pulse oximeter module
entries.notes: Some purple boards pull I2C up to 1.8 V; check before use.

entries.name: TTP223 capacitive touch module
entries.notes: Output mode (momentary/toggle) and active level are set by solder pads; module pin order varies.

entries.name: RC522 RFID reader
entries.notes: 3.3 V supply only.

entries.name: HC-05 Bluetooth module
entries.notes: RXD is 3.3 V: divide a 5 V TX line.

entries.name: nRF24L01+ 2.4 GHz module
entries.notes: Supply is 3.3 V only; add a 10 µF capacitor at the module.

entries.name: SIM800L GSM module
entries.notes: Needs a 3.4–4.4 V supply that delivers 2 A bursts; neither 3.3 V nor 5 V pins are suitable.

entries.name: SX1278 LoRa module (Ra-02)
entries.notes: 433 MHz band variant.

entries.name: DFPlayer Mini MP3 module
entries.notes: Add a 1 kΩ resistor in series with RX from a 5 V board.

entries.name: 0.96" SSD1306 OLED 128x64 (I2C, 4-pin)
entries.notes: Header order is GND,VCC,SCL,SDA on most boards, but VCC-first boards exist.

changes.text: Swap Adafruit_SSD1306 for Adafruit_SH110X: Adafruit_SH1106G display(128, 64, &Wire, -1); display.begin(0x3C, true); SSD1306_WHITE becomes SH110X_WHITE. Drawing calls (Adafruit GFX) are unchanged.

entries.name: 0.96" SSD1306 OLED 128x64 (SPI, 7-pin)
entries.notes: Can be converted to I2C by moving resistors.

entries.name: 1.3" SH1106 OLED 128x64 (I2C)
entries.verify: 1.3 inch modules are usually SH1106 even when listed as SSD1306; some swap VCC and GND on the header, so read the silkscreen.

entries.name: Adafruit PiOLED 128x32 (Raspberry Pi HAT)
entries.wiring_note: Wire 3V3 to Pi pin 1, SDA to pin 3, SCL to pin 5 and GND to pin 6, then enable I2C (raspi-config).

entries.name: 16x2 LCD with PCF8574 I2C backpack
entries.verify: Run an I2C scan: 0x27 = PCF8574, 0x3F = PCF8574A backpack.
entries.notes: Backpack pull-ups go to 5 V; on 3.3 V boards remove them or use a level shifter.

entries.name: MAX7219 8x8 LED matrix module
entries.notes: Input high threshold is 3.5 V; 3.3 V boards may need a level shifter.

entries.name: 2.9" e-paper module 296x128 (SPI)
entries.notes: Driver IC differs between panel revisions (SSD1680, IL0373); confirm before choosing the GxEPD2 class.

entries.name: A4988 stepper driver (StepStick)
entries.notes: About 1 A per phase without extra cooling; 2 A with heat sink and airflow.

changes.text: Re-tune the current limit: on DRV8825 it is VREF × 2.
The pin that is VDD on A4988 is FAULT on DRV8825; Pololu-style carriers protect it, but check clones.
STEP high and low must each last at least 1.9 µs: call stepper.setMinPulseWidth(2) (AccelStepper) and check delayMicroseconds(1) loops.
Microstep tables differ (up to 1/32); update steps per mm.
MS1/MS2 select different microstep tables; MS3 becomes SPREAD (tie to GND for StealthChop).
Handle the PDN/UART pin as the module's documentation describes.
Motor supply is 5.5–28 V (A4988: 8–35 V); re-tune VREF with the module's own formula.
STEP/DIR code is unchanged; some modules invert DIR. TMCStepper is optional for UART current control.

entries.name: L298N dual H-bridge module
entries.notes: About 2 V drop across the bridge; runs hot above 1 A.

entries.name: MG996R servo
entries.notes: Stall current up to about 2.5 A: do not power from a board's 5 V pin.

entries.name: 28BYJ-48 5 V stepper motor
entries.notes: A 12 V variant exists; check the label.

entries.name: NEMA 17 stepper motor
entries.notes: Rated current and holding torque vary by model (17HS4401: about 1.7 A).

entries.name: WS2812B addressable LED (strip, ring or pixel)
entries.notes: Data high threshold is 0.7 × VDD (3.5 V at 5 V); add a 300–500 Ω series resistor and a 470 µF capacitor.

entries.name: 1-channel 5 V relay module (10 A 250 VAC)
entries.notes: Most Indian modules are active-LOW; some have an H/L jumper. Contacts above 2 A on resistive loads need margin.

entries.name: SSR-25DA solid-state relay (DC control, AC load)
entries.notes: Many units sold are counterfeit with lower real ratings: derate heavily and use a heat sink.

entries.name: PowerSwitch Tail II (US 120 V)
entries.notes: US 120 V / 60 Hz product with a NEMA plug; unusable on Indian mains.

entries.name: AMS1117-3.3 regulator module
entries.notes: Dropout about 1.1 V; gets hot above a few hundred mA from 12 V.

entries.name: LM2596 adjustable buck converter
entries.notes: Adjustable output: set it with a multimeter before connecting the load. 3 A peak, about 2 A continuous.

entries.name: MT3608 adjustable boost converter
entries.notes: Adjustable output up to about 28 V; set it before connecting the load.

entries.name: TP4056 Li-ion charger with DW01 protection
entries.notes: Single-cell Li-ion/LiPo only; charge current set by RPROG (1 A default).

entries.name: TP4056 Li-ion charger (no protection)
entries.verify: Protected boards have a DW01 chip and two MOSFETs plus OUT+/OUT- pads; the bare board has only B+/B-.

entries.name: HLK-PM01 5 V 3 W AC-DC module
entries.notes: Bare mains module: needs a fuse, insulation and an enclosure.

entries.name: 12 V 2 A SMPS adapter (Indian plug)
entries.notes: Prefer BIS-marked adapters; check the barrel size (5.5×2.1 vs 5.5×2.5).

entries.name: 18650 Li-ion cell
entries.notes: Protection circuit present only on 'protected' cells; check before use.

entries.name: 9 V battery
entries.notes: Low capacity; poor choice for motors.

entries.name: 4-channel BSS138 logic level converter
entries.notes: Bidirectional; fine for I2C, too slow for WS2812B data.

entries.name: 74AHCT125 quad level shifter
entries.notes: One-way 3.3 V to 5 V; the usual choice for WS2812B data.

entries.name: DS3231 RTC module
entries.notes: Shares 0x68 with MPU6050; its AT24C32 EEPROM sits at 0x57.

entries.name: Micro SD card module (SPI)
entries.notes: Common blue module has a 3.3 V regulator and level shifter; needs 5 V on VCC.

entries.name: USB-A to micro-B cable
entries.notes: Many cheap cables are charge-only; confirm data lines for uploading.

entries.name: 1N4007 rectifier diode
entries.notes: 1 A, 1000 V; slow, not for switching supplies.

entries.name: IRLZ44N logic-level MOSFET
entries.notes: Logic-level gate, specified at VGS 5 V; marginal but usable at 3.3 V for small loads.

entries.name: IRF520 MOSFET module
entries.notes: Not a logic-level MOSFET: barely turns on from 3.3 V or even 5 V at high current.

entries.name: Active buzzer (5 V)
entries.verify: An active buzzer sounds on plain DC; a passive one only clicks.

entries.name: Passive buzzer
entries.notes: Needs a tone() signal.

entries.name: Piezo disc element
entries.notes: Can produce tens of volts on impact: add a 1 MΩ resistor and clamp before an ADC pin.
